title: Measurement invariance between human and machine respondents on cognitive assessments: code, data and results
description:
Code, data and results for M. H. Siddiqui, "Measurement Invariance Between Human and Machine Respondents on Cognitive Assessments," IEEE CogMI 2026.

Contents:

  • The anchored DIF estimation library.
  • The machine-administration harness.
  • The analysis scripts and the camera-ready checks.
  • The pre-registration (not deposited with a registry).
  • Scored machine responses for eight open-weight models (main and temperature-0 arms) and an item index for the 25 ICAR items.
  • The SAPA ICAR reference data (CC0).
  • All results files from which the paper's numbers are read.

ICAR item text and keys are not included: they are under the PsychArchives Scientific Use Licence (doi:10.23668/psycharchives.22167). Versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23175504, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23198554) included item material in error and their files are restricted; see CHANGELOG.md.

Code: MIT. Data: CC BY 4.0 for the machine responses; see DATA_LICENSES.md for the rest.
